title: Union food subsidy (PMGKAY)
definition: Central government revenue expenditure on food subsidy (primarily Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana free foodgrain distribution), compiled by RBI from Union Budget documents.

sources.title: RBI Bulletin — Union Budget 2025-26: An Assessment (Table 2 & Annex I)

points.evidence: RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I / Table 2, row 'Food', column 2022-23 (Actuals): 273 thousand crore INR (273,000 crore INR).
RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I / Table 2, row 'Food', column 2023-24 (Actuals): 212 thousand crore INR (212,000 crore INR).
RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I / Table 2, row 'Food', column 2024-25 (RE): 197 thousand crore INR (197,000 crore INR).
points.estimate_method: Compiled from official Union Budget documents (Revised Estimates / Budget Estimates) in RBI Bulletin.

points.evidence: RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I / Table 2, row 'Food', column 2025-26 (BE): 203 thousand crore INR (203,000 crore INR).
